basic_info.description: Welcome to 71 Manor Drive a fully detached 5-bedroom + office, 4-bathroom home that has been fully remodeled while preserving its original charm. Restored hardwood parquet floors, vintage doors, and trim blend seamlessly with modern design and high-end finishes. The open-concept main level offers a spacious living and dining area with wood-burning fireplace, Lutron-controlled lighting, and elegant detailing. The chef's kitchen features marble counters, custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and a built-in Siemens espresso machine. Three bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with spa-style bath, plus a second bath with soaking tub, complete this level. Downstairs offers two ensuite bedrooms with heated floors, a private office, laundry room, and a large family/entertainment space with custom wet bar, wine fridge, beverage fridge, and dishwasher. Indoor-outdoor living shines with sliding doors to a landscaped yard with built-in BBQ, fire pit, heaters, and potential for a dedicated dog run. Modern amenities include dual-zone heating & A/C, EV charging readiness, smart cameras, and Nest thermostats. Located in Mount Davidson Manor near top-rated schools, Ocean Ave shops, West Portal, Stonestown, Lake Merced, and Ocean Beach. A rare blend of style, comfort, and location.
